title: 叠加命名空间 Pod 日志权限并保留原有访问基线
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台提供 Python/PyYAML 离线校验。role.yaml 的规则为空，绑定、原有 training/staging 权限和默认身份快照只读。它们都是训练材料，不是线上 kubeconfig。

## 操作任务
仅补充 role.yaml 的 rules，保持 Role 名称 log-reader、namespace training 和 binding.yaml 原样。目标身份是 system:serviceaccount:training:learner，既有默认身份、默认命名空间、原有 Role/RoleBinding 都不可修改。
新增的权限必须恰好为 training 的 core API pods:get/list/watch 和 pods/log:get，针对所有 Pod（包括未来 Pod、无 fieldSelector 的集合读取）。不能额外授权日志 list/watch、exec/attach、Secret、修改/删除/创建、bind/escalate/impersonate，也不能放宽到其他 API group、命名空间或账号。
既有 training events:get/list/watch、仅 team-settings ConfigMap 的 get，以及 staging jobs:get/list 均须保留；它们来自只读基线，不要复制到新 Role，不得误将新增 Role 当成替换基线。另一个命名空间的同名 ServiceAccount 不是同一身份。
支持 1–12 条 resource rules，可拆分/重排等价规则，字段限 apiGroups/resources/verbs/resourceNames；本次新增仅限显式 pods、pods/log 与 get/list/watch，不使用 wildcard、nonResourceURLs、ClusterRole 或新增绑定。
本题是网页里的离线授权增量配置练习。没有连接 API Server，也不模拟其他授权器、真实认证、RBAC缓存或 live kubectl auth can-i；不会要求你在外部打开 Kubernetes。

## 产物
完整 role.yaml，其他素材不变。

## 验收方法
解析实际 YAML，通过 RoleBinding 精确解析身份与范围，对原有权限并集和新增权限逐项验证；覆盖资源/子资源、API group、账号、命名空间、verbs、对象名与集合读取。等价分组可通过，越权或收缩既有权限失败。通过只证明限定离线模型，不证明真实集群授权。

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: {name: log-reader, namespace: training}
rules: []

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: existing-observer
  namespace: training
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - ''

  - events
  verbs:
  - get
  - list
  - watch
- apiGroups:
  - ''
  resources:
  - configmaps
  resourceNames:
  - team-settings
  verbs:
  - get
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: existing-observer
  namespace: training
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: existing-observer
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: learner
  namespace: training
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: existing-job-reader
  namespace: staging
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - batch
  resources:
  - jobs
  verbs:
  - get
  - list
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: existing-job-reader
  namespace: staging
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: existing-job-reader
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: learner
  namespace: training

solution_files.role.yaml:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: {name: log-reader, namespace: training}
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods/log]
    verbs: [get]

answer:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: {name: log-reader, namespace: training}
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods/log]
    verbs: [get]
```

RoleBinding 在 training 引用 log-reader，并绑定 training/learner；Role规则是加法。pods/log 与 pods 是独立资源字符串，查看Pod并不自动得到日志。把pods/log与pods放进同一条包含list/watch的规则会额外授权日志list/watch。不能限制resourceNames来伪装“全部Pod”，也不能通过换默认身份实现权限增加。基线Role保留后，staging已有jobs权限仍保留。

原知识点：### `role.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: {name: log-reader, namespace: training}
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [pods/log]
    verbs: [get]
```

日志是pods/log子资源；Role范围限当前命名空间。保持绑定和默认身份不变。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

ROOT=Path.cwd()
for rel,digest in {'binding.yaml': '8cb25fe1f7f3f33197da52877ee0243edc9924deacaa64390af49f9de5b7f22c', 'fixtures/existing-access.yaml': 'f11b9d60718db53380ac1dc40b4d0707d33568eb650364664c51951edb7d394f', 'fixtures/default-access.json': '08745ba2e9e5ab21a5edf96448f636a5a2a278daaa7d7f7413ad20f573ccfa2f'}.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly binding, original permission or default identity changed: '+rel
class Strict(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
def mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
    result={}
    for k,v in node.value:
        key=loader.construct_object(k,deep=deep)
        assert isinstance(key,str) and key not in result,'duplicate/nonstring YAML key'
        result[key]=loader.construct_object(v,deep=deep)
    return result
Strict.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
docs=[x for x in yaml.load_all((ROOT/'role.yaml').read_text(),Loader=Strict) if x is not None]
assert len(docs)==1,'one Role only, no extra RBAC objects'
role=docs[0]
assert set(role)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','rules'}
assert role['apiVersion']=='rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1' and role['kind']=='Role'
assert role['metadata']=={'name':'log-reader','namespace':'training'},'identity and namespace must stay unchanged'
rules=role['rules'];assert isinstance(rules,list) and 1<=len(rules)<=12,'1..12 rules supported'
for rule in rules:
    assert isinstance(rule,dict) and set(rule)<={'apiGroups','resources','verbs','resourceNames'}
    for field in ('apiGroups','resources','verbs'):
        assert isinstance(rule.get(field),list) and rule[field] and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in rule[field])
    if 'resourceNames' in rule:assert isinstance(rule['resourceNames'],list) and all(isinstance(n,str) and n for n in rule['resourceNames'])
    assert set(rule['apiGroups'])=={''},'core API group only'
    assert set(rule['resources'])<={'pods','pods/log'},'new Role must not grant unrelated resources or wildcard capabilities'
    assert set(rule['verbs'])<={'get','list','watch'},'new Role must not grant write or special verbs'
baseline=list(yaml.safe_load_all((ROOT/'fixtures/existing-access.yaml').read_text()))
new_binding=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/'binding.yaml').read_text())
identity=json.loads((ROOT/'fixtures/default-access.json').read_text())['current_user']
assert identity=='system:serviceaccount:training:learner'

def allows(objects,user,namespace,group,resource,verb,name):
    for bound in objects:
        if bound['kind']!='RoleBinding' or bound['metadata']['namespace']!=namespace:continue
        if not any(s['kind']=='ServiceAccount' and user=='system:serviceaccount:'+s['namespace']+':'+s['name'] for s in bound['subjects']):continue
        target=next((x for x in objects if x['kind']=='Role' and x['metadata']['namespace']==namespace and x['metadata']['name']==bound['roleRef']['name']),None)
        if target is None:continue
        for rule in target['rules']:
            if group not in rule['apiGroups'] or resource not in rule['resources'] or verb not in rule['verbs']:continue
            if rule.get('resourceNames') and name not in rule['resourceNames']:continue
            return True
    return False

names={'','api-0','worker-7','team-settings','other-config','future-pod-0192'}
for rule in rules:names.update(rule.get('resourceNames',[]))
# A fresh name proves that finite resourceNames cannot masquerade as every Pod.
fresh='__not_in_resourceNames__'
while fresh in names:fresh+='x'
names.add(fresh)
cases=0; added=baseline+[role,new_binding]
for user,ns,group,resource,verb,name in itertools.product(
 (identity,'system:serviceaccount:staging:learner','system:serviceaccount:training:observer'),
 ('training','staging','production',''),('','apps','batch','rbac.authorization.k8s.io'),
 ('pods','pods/log','pods/exec','pods/attach','pods/status','secrets','events','configmaps','jobs','deployments','roles','serviceaccounts/token','nodes'),
 ('get','list','watch','create','update','patch','delete','deletecollection','bind','escalate','impersonate'),sorted(names)):
    before=allows(baseline,user,ns,group,resource,verb,name)
    requested=(user==identity and ns=='training' and group=='' and ((resource=='pods' and verb in ('get','list','watch')) or (resource=='pods/log' and verb=='get')))
    after=allows(added,user,ns,group,resource,verb,name)
    assert after==(before or requested),'permission delta mismatch: '+repr((user,ns,group,resource,verb,name,before,after))
    cases+=1
# Collection calls have no object name. Exact filtering of resourceNames above
# is intentionally not a model of label/field selectors or an API request.
assert allows(added,identity,'training','','pods','list','')
assert allows(added,identity,'staging','batch','jobs','list','')
assert allows(added,identity,'training','','configmaps','get','team-settings')
assert not allows(added,identity,'training','','configmaps','get','other-config')
print('Offline Role/RoleBinding grant union and preserved defaults passed',cases,'matrix cases; no live authorization request was sent')

assessment.validation_scope: Offline exact resource rule and RoleBinding union only; not a Kubernetes authorization server, authentication or other authorizers.

body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页内清单配置练习，平台需要Python/PyYAML离线验收器；不连接Kubernetes、不创建云负载均衡、不要求学员另开集群。附带程序、节点拓扑和IP是未部署的训练素材。

## 操作任务

## 产物
- service.yaml：按题意修复配置，其余素材固定。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py解析实际YAML，检查目标配置、资源身份和namespace范围，核对题定Service/Pod/端口关联；拒绝额外资源、错误类型、重复键、越界字段和无关素材改动。多文档顺序、键顺序、带name的列表顺序不影响结果。此合同仅验配置，不能证明DNS解析、源地址保留、流量连通或真实集群恢复。

files.service.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service

CHART_ROOT='chart'
CHART_FILES=['chart/Chart.yaml', 'chart/values.yaml', 'chart/templates/configmap.yaml', 'chart/templates/deployment.yaml']
import os, json, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, re, copy
import yaml
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,release="lab",namespace="training",file_overrides=None,lint=False,expect_failure=False,schema_failure=False):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-contract-") as temp:
        chart=pathlib.Path(temp)/"chart";chart.mkdir()
        for name in CHART_FILES:
            relative=pathlib.Path(name).relative_to(CHART_ROOT) if CHART_ROOT else pathlib.Path(name)
            dst=chart/relative;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            dst.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8")
        if values is not None:(chart/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8")
        for name,text in (file_overrides or {}).items():
            target=(chart/name).resolve()
            assert target.is_relative_to(chart.resolve())
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_text(text,encoding="utf8")
        if lint:
            p=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint",str(chart)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr+p.stdout
        p=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,str(chart),"--namespace",namespace],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        if expect_failure:
            assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid values unexpectedly rendered"
            if schema_failure:assert "schema" in (p.stdout+p.stderr).lower(),"must reject through schema"
            return p.stderr+p.stdout
        assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr+p.stdout
        docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(p.stdout) if d is not None]
        assert all(isinstance(d,dict) for d in docs)
        return docs
def one(docs,kind):
    found=[d for d in docs if d.get("kind")==kind]
    assert len(found)==1,(kind,docs)
    return found[0]

def observed(message,rel):
    docs=render({"message":message},release=rel,lint=True)
    assert len(docs)==2
    cm=one(docs,"ConfigMap");dep=one(docs,"Deployment")
    assert cm["metadata"]["name"]==rel+"-config" and cm["data"]["message"]==message
    pod=dep["spec"]["template"];checksum=pod["metadata"]["annotations"]["checksum/config"]
    assert isinstance(checksum,str) and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}",checksum)
    cs=pod["spec"]["containers"]
    assert len(cs)==1 and cs[0]["image"]=="nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.28-alpine"
    mounts=[m for m in cs[0].get("volumeMounts",[]) if m.get("mountPath")=="/etc/training"]
    assert len(mounts)==1 and mounts[0].get("readOnly") is True
    vols=[v for v in pod["spec"].get("volumes",[]) if v["name"]==mounts[0]["name"]]
    assert len(vols)==1 and vols[0]["configMap"]["name"]==cm["metadata"]["name"]
    return checksum
a=observed("hello","alpha");assert observed("hello","alpha")==a
b=observed("changed","alpha");assert b!=a
c=observed("hello","beta");assert c!=a

print("Helm semantic contract complete")

BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")

  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr

  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run

 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]

   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])

   return None

  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode()).hexdigest()==digest,"readonly material changed"
expected={x for x in FILES if x.endswith((".tf",".tf.json"))}

assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"
